ai agent.why: robot head reads as an AI agent

allowed / passed.why: a tick in a circle reads as allowed

control (guardrail family).why: an enforced yes/no: the request is allowed or blocked

cross-module read / coupled to another m.why: a view on another module's tables ties you to its columns; provisional, swap if a better fit turns up

database table.why: grid of rows and columns: one table, not the whole database

denied / blocked.why: an x in a circle reads as denied

detector (guardrail family).why: a scanner: estimates whether something looks like an attack, can miss

estimate / probability.why: a % sign says likelihood, not a yes/no

estimation / statistical correction.why: a sum sign: correcting the reported rate with statistics

eval criteria / rubric.why: a checklist with ticks: the rubric a person defines

factuality / grounding.why: a verified mark: the answer is checked against sources

hook (must happen).why: a webhook is the event-triggered callback a hook is

human labellers / people.why: a group of people: the humans whose labels are ground truth

input guardrail.why: an arrow entering: what the user sends in

judge validation (human labels).why: a person with a tick: humans confirm the judge

mcp (reach).why: a plug reads as a connection to something outside

module (bounded context in a monolith).why: a sealed box: one module with its own contents

newsletter: original note.why: a notebook and pen: a written note

operational / cost limits.why: a dial: budgets, rate limits, timeouts

output guardrail.why: a reply bubble: what the model says back

privacy / data access.why: access restricted to who is allowed

prompt (what i want now).why: a speech bubble reads as a request typed to the model

re-validation / re-check.why: arrows round: check again when the model changes

refund / money moves.why: a banknote is the plainest money symbol

reporting store / data store.why: a separate store the modules feed; provisional, swap if a better fit turns up

retrieval / RAG.why: a data store queried on demand

retry at every layer / repeated tries.why: loop arrows: the call goes round again

retry at one point / single retry.why: loop arrows with a 1: retries happen in one place only

row versions (mvcc).why: stacked copies: one row, several versions

series: read the source.why: an open book: one idea from a book being read

series: the tradeoff.why: a balance: one decision, what it cost

series: think in systems.why: connected boxes: system boundaries and integration

series: what ai gets wrong.why: a warning mark: AI's failure modes

skill (judgment).why: a graduation cap reads as learned know-how

tool calls.why: a tool being used: the agent acting

warning / should not happen.why: a warning triangle flags the refund that shouldn't have gone through
